case.mfg-leads.story.0: An 800-person precision parts maker adds ~40 CRM leads daily. Sales said high-value leads were first touched 2–3 hours later — after competitors.
case.mfg-leads.story.1: **First pilot**: “Full-auto outbound” as the first scenario. After 4 weeks, sales pushed back — uncontrolled scripts, poor CX, unclear attribution. IT raised compliance concerns; pilot stopped.
case.mfg-leads.story.2: **Pivot**: “Agent drafts + human confirms before send.” Within 30 minutes of a new CRM lead, the agent drafts follow-up from the profile; sales reviews and sends in one click.
case.mfg-leads.story.3: **Acceptance**: 200 anonymized real leads — P50 first response 3.2h → 28 min, 72% adoption. Sales lead and IT signed off; project moved to commercial approval.
case.mfg-leads.story.4: **Shareable pack**: Case detail and [one-pager](/downloads/one-pager-mfg.pdf) on [Cases](/cases); peers can browse [Manufacturing solutions](/industry/mfg).
case.mfg-leads.story.5: **Lesson**: Keep a [human-confirm path](/trust/security-faq) for the first scenario; agree metrics in writing — honest pivots pass internal review better than “full auto” hype.

pricing.faq.0.q: How to choose among the four tiers?
pricing.faq.0.a: Trial: Free; solo/micro team (≤3): Plus; production commercial: Business; private deploy/compliance: Enterprise.
pricing.faq.1.a: Plus forbids scaled commercial use — indie devs or ≤3-person micro teams for self-use/prototypes only. External business: Business+.
pricing.faq.2.a: In Runtime, change menus, form fields, and widgets in natural language (e.g. “change leave start to date picker”); each successful change counts once; clarifications do not. Picking catalog modules to publish does not use compose-edit quota.
pricing.faq.3.a: Describe in one sentence to generate a full interactive page (mini-games, tools, etc.) or revise an existing page; picking catalog capabilities does not count. Unlike compose edit (change existing menus/forms), smart page generation builds a whole page from scratch.
pricing.faq.4.a: Enough for trial and tweaks. After 10 successful changes/day, wait until tomorrow or upgrade to Plus (unlimited).
pricing.faq.5.q: What does Free’s “1 Smart page generation/day” mean?
pricing.faq.5.a: One AI-generated (or fully revised) interactive page per day. Catalog capabilities and compose-edit form tweaks don’t use this quota.
pricing.faq.6.q: How is Business’s 2,000 AI pages/month counted?
pricing.faq.6.a: Shared per org, monthly. Compose edits unlimited on Business. Catalog picks don’t count toward AI page quota.
pricing.faq.7.q: How to get a custom quote?
pricing.faq.7.a: Business: chat online or book a demo. Enterprise private/compliance: request a proposal for a written quote.
trust.security-whitepaper.title: BlockHub Information Security Whitepaper
trust.security-whitepaper.subtitle: Enterprise assessment · data residency · encryption & access · deletion
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.0.p.0: For enterprise IT and security teams — BlockHub practices for storage, transport encryption, access control, and deletion.
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.0.p.1: Cross-check with the [Trust Center](/trust); for full DPA and compliance alignment, [book a demo](/#contact-demo) for the qualification pack.
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.1.p.0: Customer business data (app config, KB docs, forms, etc.) is stored by default in **mainland China** data centers.
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.1.p.1: Without written customer authorization, data is **not used** for model training or shared with third parties for marketing.
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.1.p.2: Cross-border access requires explicit enablement and supplemental terms; overseas admin login is off by default.
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.2.p.0: Admin and employee endpoints use **HTTPS/TLS 1.2+** end-to-end; APIs support mTLS (hybrid/private optional).
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.2.p.1: Data at rest uses **AES-256**; keys in cloud KMS or customer HSM (private deploy optional).
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.2.p.2: Sensitive fields (phone, ID, etc.) support column-level masking and export controls.
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.3.p.1: Critical actions (login, permission changes, export, agent publish) are **fully logged** — default 180 days, extendable to 1 year.
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.3.p.2: CSV/JSON export supported; field reference in [audit log sample](/trust/audit-log).
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.4.p.0: Within **30 calendar days** of contract end or written request, data is deleted with confirmation letter.
trust.security-whitepaper.sec.4.p.1: Backups cleared per rolling policy; sub-processor deletion confirmation available.

trust.deployment.sec.0.p.0: BlockHub offers **standard PaaS / hybrid / private** tiers for different data sensitivity and IT capacity.

trust.deployment.sec.1.p.0: Apps and metadata on BlockHub domestic cluster; **first scenario in as little as 5 minutes**.

trust.security-faq.title: Enterprise security questionnaire — pre-filled handbook
trust.security-faq.subtitle: Common frameworks · pre-fill samples · scope notes
trust.security-faq.sec.0.p.0: **42 of 50** common security questions pre-filled below (excerpt). Full Word/PDF with source pages after demo.
trust.security-faq.sec.0.p.1: Ask online: site agents can cite this material in answers.
trust.security-faq.sec.1.p.0: **Q: Is customer data used for model training?** A: No. Not used for training by default; optional LLM calls process only the current request.
trust.security-faq.sec.1.p.1: **Q: Private LLM supported?** A: Yes — customer intranet or specified API (hybrid/private).
trust.security-faq.sec.1.p.2: **Q: Data deletion process?** A: Written request → delete within 30 days → confirmation letter.
trust.security-faq.sec.2.p.0: **Q: Classified Protection Level 2?** A: Hybrid/private can align to Level 2 controls; gap analysis and remediation guidance provided.
trust.security-faq.sec.2.p.1: **Q: Log retention?** A: Default 180 days, configurable to 1 year; see [audit log sample](/trust/audit-log).
trust.security-faq.sec.2.p.2: **Q: Penetration test report?** A: Annual summary for contracted customers under NDA.
trust.audit-log.title: Audit log samples & retention policy
trust.audit-log.subtitle: Field spec · retention · export & SIEM
trust.audit-log.sec.0.p.0: Logs cover admin console and key APIs: login/logout, permission changes, app publish, export, agent config changes.
trust.audit-log.sec.0.p.1: For security audit, troubleshooting, compliance — **not tamperable by regular admins**.
trust.audit-log.sec.1.p.0: `timestamp` (UTC+8); `actor` account; `action` type; `resource` object ID; `ip` source; `result` success/fail; `detail` JSON extension.
trust.audit-log.sec.1.p.1: Example: `2026-07-08 14:32:01 | zhangsan | app.publish | app_8f3a | 10.0.1.22 | success | version=1.2.0`
trust.audit-log.sec.2.p.0: Default retention **180 days**; finance/gov customers up to 365 days (hybrid/private).
trust.audit-log.sec.2.p.1: Filter by time, actor, action type; export CSV/JSON.
